profile.headline: Validation & Embedded Software Engineer — driving innovation in embedded systems, validation, automation, and system-level debug for silicon, and IP integration
profile.summary:
Versatile and results-driven Software and Validation Engineer with over 20 years of experience in embedded systems, silicon validation, and software development across automotive, healthcare, and semiconductor domains. Proven success in developing and executing pre- and post-silicon validation strategies, developing automated test suites, and debugging HW acceleration subsystems. 

Extensive hands-on experience with microcontroller-based firmware, RTOS environments, and low-level driver development for EEPROMs, ADCs, timers, and motors. Skilled in optimizing power consumption and memory usage in resource-constrained embedded platforms. Expert in emulation tools (Simics, HAPS, ZeBu), C language, scripting (Python, Shell, microcode), and communication protocols including PCIe, CAN, SPI, and I²C. 

Passionate about building scalable verification environments and accelerating debug cycles through intelligent automation and cross-functional collaboration.

positions.title: Validation Test Execution Lead
positions.description:
• Owned end‑to‑end firmware lifecycle for BIOS, BMC, and CPLD on data‑center test platforms; standardized and automated update process, cutting platform maintenance windows by 40%. Executed regression tests for firmware releases.

• Improved emulation‑platform utilization by leading the implementation of an automated idle‑time alert system, increasing machine usage by 15%.

• Led execution of over 1,000+ validation test cases across Pre‑Silicon, Power‑On, and Post‑Silicon phases for an IP project; achieved 100% planned test execution ahead of schedule with an 85% pass rate.

• Developed and deployed cloud‑hosted automated test suites and CI pipelines to enable 24/7 Power‑On, volume validation, and regression testing, grounded on three pillars: known‑good test content, known‑good platform, and known‑good firmware.

• Delivered daily test‑status dashboards and KPI metrics to leadership to support milestone decisions and release readiness.

positions.title: System Validation Engineer
positions.description:
• Authored comprehensive validation test plans to expose design flaws and achieve full RTL coverage for hardware accelerator IP, driving closure of critical verification gaps prior to tape‑in.

• Engineered C, Python, and low‑level microcode test scripts to verify IP Memory and Slice Management features across pre‑silicon and post‑silicon platforms, ensuring functional compliance with specifications.

• Executed test cases on Simics, HAPS, and Zebu platforms, uncovering corner-case bugs and enhancing platform stability.

• Collaborated closely with architecture, RTL design, and firmware teams to review IP specifications, validate functionality, and triage defects discovered by test cases—accelerating defect resolution ahead of Product Release Qualification.

• Mentored junior validation engineers in test execution, automation best practices, and structured debug workflows.

• Contributed to cross‑organizational innovation forums and task forces to evaluate new validation tools and propose process improvements.

positions.title: Software Information Developer II
positions.description:
•	Developed scalable healthcare solutions using C, SQL, and Shell scripting, ensuring HIPAA compliance and system reliability
•	Automated data pipelines and Oracle queries, improving reporting speed and accuracy while eliminating manual processes
•	Engineered EDI file generation based on 834 Companion Guides, enabling seamless integration with multiple trading partners
•	Led debugging and job scheduling efforts using GDB and AutoSys/JIL, enhancing application stability and operational efficiency
positions.insights: Skills: C (Programming Language) · Red Hat Linux · Git · Agile Methodologies · Oracle Database · Shell Scripting · Scrum · Linux · Unix · Gitlab · Debugging · UNIX Utilities · Awk · GitHub · SQL · Debugging Code

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Designed and tested embedded software for instrumentation clusters and diagnostic monitors using 8-, 16-, and 32-bit microcontrollers.
•	Developed SPI drivers and interfaces for stepper motors, with hands-on debugging via JTAG and experience across CAN, SPI, and J1939 protocols.
•	Translated user needs into clear software requirements, reconciling technical constraints with operational goals.
•	Delivered production-ready code aligned with automotive standards, contributing to robust and scalable embedded systems.
positions.insights: Skills: C (Programming Language) · Code Coverage · Embedded Software Programming · Sensors · GPIO · Bios · Unix · Debugging · Firmware · CAN bus · Embedded C · Controller Area Network (CAN) · Debugging Code · Embedded Systems

positions.title: Professor
positions.description:
• Conducted assigned undergraduate classes in: Microcontrollers, Sensors, LabView and Electronics. 
• Additionally, served as academic advisor to students.

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Led full lifecycle development of embedded software in C and Assembly for automotive platforms, delivering high-volume production solutions with minimal supervision
•	Developed firmware for motors, sensors, and analog inputs across 8-, 16-, and 32-bit microcontrollers, optimizing performance and memory usage
•	Implemented low-level drivers and hardware routines (EEPROM, I2C, ADC, interrupts), ensuring robust integration with CAN, LIN, SPI, and I2C architectures
•	Collaborated with cross-functional teams and maintained project metrics (SLOCs, throughput, defects), driving quality and alignment with CMMi standards

Key achievements
•	Successfully lead software projects for new and existing products under little supervision, delivering on time and developing them prototype phase into high-volume production.
•	Implemented code for hardware resources, such as EEPROM, I2C bus, timers, ADC conversion, interrupts, power-up and power-down routines.
•	Accurately performed Configuration Management support
•	Created script files to automate compilation and linking of source files using compilers commands and Perl on a regular basis.

positions.title: Process Engineer
positions.description:
•	Responsible for the preplanning of new product launch (at the Lead Preparation Area). This will include calculate lead volumes, machines capabilities, and the requirement for new tools, processes and materials.
•	Enhanced the way the information from the Bill of Materials (BOM) was handled. For this I implemented a system to download the information from the BOM, through the use of scripts and databases in Access 97 and Visual Basic 5.0. This would help to manage the information more efficiently, reducing costs and delivering information faster. 
• In charge of coordinating engineering changes (information flow) according with customer's requirements. Developed manuals and procedures and implemented training course for new recruits.
